column1: # Letter cipher of W 004 Nr. 52 (fuerstenberg1659): two alternating Caesar shifts on the 24-letter alphabet
# a b c d e f g h i k l m n o p q r s t u w x y z (no j, no v). Odd places of each run (1st, 3rd, ...): plain =
# cipher moved back 1; even places: plain = cipher moved back 8. The count restarts at each cipher run.
# Equivalent to a Vigenere with key "bi" on this alphabet. Recovered ciphertext-only (no gloss, no key on the leaf).
